title: Solar System Basics
description: Planets, the Sun and our place in the galaxy.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explain: Mercury orbits the Sun at about 58 million km.

questions.question: The Sun is a planet.
questions.explain: The Sun is a star. It holds almost all the mass of the solar system.

questions.question: Which is the largest planet?
questions.explain: Jupiter is more than 300 times the mass of Earth.

questions.question: Which planet is famous for its rings?
questions.explain: Saturn's rings are made of ice and rock.

questions.question: How many planets are in the solar system?
questions.explain: Eight. Pluto is now classed as a dwarf planet.

questions.question: Venus is the hottest planet.
questions.explain: Venus averages about 465 °C, hotter than Mercury, because of its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere.

questions.question: Which planet is called the Red Planet?
questions.explain: Iron-rich dust gives Mars its rusty color.

questions.question: What is the name of our galaxy?
questions.explain: The solar system sits in one arm of the Milky Way.
